title: The superstring: one attack chain per target, an attacker on every zone and piece, run to the end
note: Uploaded by a second agent on Tubai's command, 20 October 2026, from a read-only study of the four target repositories and the second attack pass. The chains are run by bllm/superstring.py (anaxia superstring).
closure_rule: A stage closes only on a certificate of kind lean-here, lean-external, proved or computed, checked by someone other than its producer (Lean, an independent check, or a refereed publication). A claim, a conditional statement, an unrefereed input, a scout estimate or a self-checked computation never closes a stage. A target is closed exactly when every stage of its chain is closed, the bypass stage included; the bypass stage closes only when the engine already holds a certificate that implies the target. No target is closed by the bundled data.

hodge.statement: (F2) the Hodge conjecture for abelian varieties, and (F3') every Hodge class comes from abelian varieties; together they are the Hodge conjecture (H8 thm:final).

gaps.papers_do: H8 Section 23 deduces thm:weilsix, thm:kspowers, cor:mumfordall, cor:k3all and prop:k3twosmall from the OpenAI hypotheses (P2)-(P4)
gaps.missing: the three preprints were withdrawn on 7 October 2026 (sign error, I_new = -2m), so those deductions rest on nothing; the section still cites them as hypotheses and no replacement input is named

gaps.papers_do: attack (F2) as one statement through the Weil classes and the lifts from CM points
gaps.missing: no ledger of (F2) by Mumford-Tate type, so the first open piece (Weil fourfolds of nontrivial discriminant) is never isolated as the target, and no refuter is paired with any construction

gaps.papers_do: H8 thm:f2propagation and prop:cmfamily, with (P1), reduce (F2) to lifting algebraicity from CM members of abelian schemes, and prop:jacobiancontinuation shows line bundles on C^(g-1) pushed to the Jacobian do not continue the certificates for g >= 4
gaps.missing: not one lift is attempted: no explicit semiregular object exists at any CM point for a CM field of degree at least four; the only objects certified are Markman's at discriminant one

gaps.papers_do: H8 excludes every convolution on E_0^6 whose Weil pieces sit within six consecutive shifts (cor:efoursix) and, on E_0^8, within three (thm:efourthreelevels)
gaps.missing: arrangements wider than six values on E_0^6 and wider than three on E_0^8 are open (rem:convolutionsopen); the n = 4 diagonal count 104 is never met or excluded

gaps.papers_do: every member at which H8 exhibits algebraic Weil classes is a CM point (thm:escape); the transport intersection of the rank-18 family over Q(zeta_7)^+ is named as the first non-CM candidate
gaps.missing: the intersection is never computed; no member outside the CM locus has algebraic Weil classes anywhere in the papers

gaps.papers_do: H8 prop:coversreach shows (P5) with thm:main cannot reach the open Weil families except in one boundary case: etale cyclic covers of degree 3, 4, 6 of genus-4 curves, where H^0(K+eta) x H^0(K-eta) -> H^0(2K) must be onto at one point
gaps.missing: that surjectivity is a finite linear-algebra question at one curve and was never computed

gaps.papers_do: the lattice of integral flat characters was enumerated for sixteen cubic fields with every chi <= -32 (prop:sexticintegral)
gaps.missing: the enumeration stops at those fields and at the F-Weil part; no cubic field with a character of small -chi has been searched for as a carrier

gaps.papers_do: H8 thm:simplextype reduces the Hodge conjecture of a smooth simplex-type hypersurface to Fermat varieties of its lattice degree e; the Fermat cases of Shioda, da Silva and Jumagulov are cited
gaps.missing: the reduction is never run against the census: which Delsarte fourfold shapes are closed by the known Fermat degrees was not listed

gaps.papers_do: fermat-hodge- v2.6.0 Thm V.9 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23490234): the Fricke self-isogenies of levels 5 and 7 satisfy (f^*)^2 = -N on T, so every member of the Fricke families has complex multiplication by Q(sqrt -N), not real multiplication by sqrt N (RM by sqrt N only at van Geemen-Sarti's two fixed-point twists); HC holds on all powers and Hilbert schemes of every member. The second pass shows level 10 forces rho >= 20 and the level-13 surface R13 is CM (construct/k3frob.py), the same phenomenon
gaps.missing: chains through different surfaces (Thm. chain), mixing a 2- or 3-quotient with a 5-isogeny and ending Hodge-isometric to the start, are the only road to a new square class and are untried

gaps.papers_do: the link xi between the Weil classes and the diagonal is named and shown not to be a reduction; Mostaed's system of 2816 equations at ell = 43 is cited
gaps.missing: the system was never solved or shown inconsistent; the link is named, not attacked

gaps.papers_do: hyperkahler carriers (Markman's fourfolds of K3^[n] type, Lagrangian fibrations) certify Weil classes only at discriminant one
gaps.missing: no carrier at nontrivial discriminant is proposed; the papers' own remains list says so

gaps.papers_do: prove that blow-ups, degenerations and Fourier-Mukai equivalences relocate the defect (prop:surgery) and stop there
gaps.missing: the two blow-ups that remain useful are never computed: the exact defect bookkeeping of a blow-up, and the span of the certified discriminants, which shows that any construction must work uniformly in the discriminant because each prime is an independent class

attackers.piece: which results of H8 Section 23 rest on the withdrawn preprints (P2)-(P4), and which stand on (P1), (P5) alone
attackers.method: trace every citation of OAI26c, OAI26d, OAI26f through the proofs of Section 23 and the places that cite them; check each preprint's status in openai/math history.md
attackers.certificate: the withdrawal notice of 7 October 2026 and the citation trace
attackers.stop_rule: stop when every result of Section 23 carries the label of the inputs it needs
attackers.result: thm:weilsix, thm:kspowers, cor:kstype, cor:mumfordall, cor:k3all, prop:k3twosmall and the real-multiplication closure rest on (P2)-(P4) and are open again; prop:stabilise, lem:cliffordspan, lem:ksgenerates, cor:simplexhc, cor:vgalldegrees, cor:f2cm stand on (P1), (P5), unrefereed; the Delsarte and very-general Vandermonde results stand on their own
attackers.source: openai/math history.md (withdrawn 7 Oct 2026); H8 Section 23; atlas wall withdrawn-inputs

attackers.piece: (F2) split by Mumford-Tate type: which types of simple abelian varieties of dimension at most five carry exceptional Hodge classes, and which of those pieces are closed
attackers.method: read the classification of Moonen-Zarhin (dimension at most five) and record, type by type, whether the exceptional classes are divisor classes, Weil classes or neither, and which cases are closed (Markman at discriminant one; the classical cases); the open pieces become the targets of the next attackers
inputs: Moonen-Zarhin, Hodge classes on abelian varieties of low dimension, Math. Ann. 315 (1999)
Markman, Cycles on abelian 2n-folds of Weil type from secant sheaves on abelian n-folds
attackers.certificate: the table itself (refereed); the per-piece statuses are read from refereed sources and H8
attackers.stop_rule: stop when every type of dimension at most five has a status
attackers.result: dimension at most three closed; in dimension four the exceptional classes are Weil classes, closed at discriminant one by Markman and open at nontrivial discriminant; the dimension-five pieces are to be read from the table before any status is written for them

attackers.piece: one explicit object meeting the polarised semiregularity criterion at a CM point of a CM field of degree four
attackers.method: take a genus-4 Jacobian with real multiplication by a real quadratic field (so its square has CM by a quartic field at a CM point), form Markman's two-sheaf product on the square, compute ch and the Ext profile against H8 thm:quarticrank (r >= 80, never 100) and prop:divisortemplate; a line bundle on C^(g-1) is excluded by prop:jacobiancontinuation, so start from rank two
attackers.certificate: an object with ch in P_theta and Ext^2 = 0 against the polarised directions, its ranks certified exactly (Lean or an independent exact rerun)
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the Ext profile is certified either way; a double-precision rank is not a stop
attackers.result: not attempted in any paper; the first instance of (F2) beyond discriminant one

attackers.piece: whether any object meeting the polarised semiregularity criterion can exist at the CM point h.semiregular-jacobian works at
attackers.method: the refuter of the pincer: bound dim Ext^2 from below for every object with Chern character in P_theta on the genus-4 Jacobian square, by the cut and counting arguments that closed E_0^6 within six shifts (lem:cayleycut, thm:fewpieces) adapted to the quartic CM field; a bound above the criterion is a proved wall for the secant method at that point
attackers.certificate: an exact lower bound dim Ext^2 > r(kappa) for every admissible object, checked independently
attackers.stop_rule: stop when either the bound is proved (the method is dead at that point and h.hk-carrier-nontrivial takes over) or an admissible profile is found (handed to h.semiregular-jacobian)
attackers.result: not attempted; the papers refute only on E_0^6 and E_0^8

attackers.piece: moving a Weil class of discriminant d between dimensions: Schoen's product with a Weil surface of the same discriminant
attackers.method: H8 prop:stabilise: if the Weil classes are algebraic on one Weil 2n-fold of discriminant d then on the product with a Weil surface of discriminant d, so a certificate at one dimension spreads; use it to pick the cheapest dimension for the construction, then weaken back
attackers.certificate: a refereed or Lean-checked proof of the product step
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the proof is independently checked; it is a tool for the other attackers, not a closure
attackers.result: an unrefereed proof exists (H8 prop:stabilise); with (P2) withdrawn, no dimension beyond Markman's is certified

attackers.piece: convolutions on E_0^6 whose Weil pieces have shifts spread over seven or more values, and on E_0^8 over four or more
attackers.method: extend the Cayley-cut argument of cor:efoursix and lem:cayleycut to every arrangement with one gap of length at least two between occupied shifts; at n = 4 compute the 104 diagonal classes against the H^5 targets of three-step products
attackers.certificate: exact lower bound dim Ext^2 > 57 (n = 3) or > 104 (n = 4) for every arrangement, or one arrangement meeting the count, with the rank certified exactly
attackers.stop_rule: stop at the first arrangement whose Ext^2 cannot be bounded by cuts; then it is a candidate object for h.semiregular-jacobian
attackers.result: closed within six consecutive values at n = 3 and three at n = 4; the rest open

attackers.piece: an etale cyclic cover of degree 3 of one genus-4 curve at which H^0(K+eta) x H^0(K-eta) -> H^0(2K) is onto
attackers.method: take a genus-4 curve with an explicit 3-torsion point eta (a plane quintic with a node, or a canonical curve on a quadric cone), compute both spaces by Riemann-Roch and the multiplication map exactly over a number field or modulo a large prime; onto at one point gives the Griffiths infinitesimal criterion of prop:coversreach
attackers.certificate: an exact surjectivity certificate at one curve (the 9 x 9 multiplication matrix of full rank, computed exactly)
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the rank is certified; a positive answer makes the sixfold case conditional on (P5), never unconditional
attackers.result: named in prop:coversreach, not computed

attackers.piece: the intersection of the transport loci of the rank-18 family over Q(zeta_7)^+ with the polarised family, and one non-CM member in it
attackers.method: write the transport multipliers of the rank-18 family explicitly, intersect with the Hodge locus of the polarised Weil classes, and test whether the intersection contains a member with Hodge group not smaller than generic (thm:escape forbids CM members from deciding)
attackers.certificate: one member outside the special locus of def:speciallocus with an algebraic Weil class, certified by an explicit cycle
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the intersection is computed: empty closes the route, a CM member decides nothing, a non-CM member is the first escape
attackers.result: named as a first instance in both repositories, not computed

attackers.piece: the integral flat characters of every cubic field of discriminant below 500, with the least -chi and its F-Weil part
attackers.method: rerun H8 code/sextic_lattice.py and sextic_weil.py over the cubic fields beyond the sixteen done, record the threshold and whether any character reaches -chi < 32
attackers.certificate: the enumeration with its exact lattice data rerun independently
attackers.stop_rule: stop when a character of -chi below the exclusion threshold appears (a candidate carrier) or the discriminant bound is reached
attackers.result: sixteen cubic fields done, every chi <= -32; no exclusion follows

attackers.piece: the Delsarte fourfold shapes in six variables of degree 3 to 40 whose lattice degree e is a Fermat degree with the Hodge conjecture known
attackers.method: construct/delsarte_degree.py: enumerate the shapes of H8 code/simplex_type.py, compute e = |det R| / gcd of the (n-1)-minors of the row-difference matrix, and match e against Shioda (e <= 20, e prime), da Silva (e <= 100 coprime to 6, e = 21, 27), Jumagulov (odd e <= 199, unrefereed)
attackers.certificate: per shape: smoothness of the hypersurface and the published Fermat theorem at degree e; the reduction itself is H8 thm:simplextype, unrefereed
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the list is written; it closes instances, not (F3')
attackers.result: 1102 shapes; 51 non-Fermat shapes have e in {3, 6, 8, 9, 12, 15, 18, 20, 21, 33, 35, 63, 65, 99, 143, 195}: 37 closed by published Fermat theorems through the reduction, 14 by Jumagulov's census; the 29 sextic shapes have e in {6, 24, 30, 120, ..., 3125, ..., 3750}, all even but 3125, so no known Fermat theorem closes a non-Fermat sextic shape

attackers.piece: a chain of elliptic K3 surfaces through a 2- or 3-quotient and a 5-isogeny ending Hodge-isometric to the start, with real multiplication by a new square class (a Fricke self-isogeny alone gives CM by Q(sqrt -N) at every level, fermat-hodge- v2.6.0 Thm V.9, so RM can only come from the chain)
attackers.method: compose the Fricke self-maps of levels 5 and 7 with quotient maps of levels 2 and 3 across different surfaces (fermat-hodge- Thm. chain); test the end surface against the start by Frobenius traces (construct/k3frob.py) before any algebraic check
attackers.certificate: a chain whose composite acts on T with a square class outside {2, 3, 5, 6, 7}, its endpoint isometry certified
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the trace test rejects every chain of length at most three, or one passes
attackers.result: the single-surface route closed by the second pass (level 10: rho >= 20; level 13: R13 is CM, rho = 16) and by fermat-hodge- v2.6.0 (levels 5, 7: CM by Q(sqrt -5), Q(sqrt -7))

attackers.piece: Mostaed's system of 2816 equations at ell = 43 for the link xi
attackers.method: generate the system, reduce modulo several primes and over Q, and report consistency; an inconsistency closes the link at ell = 43, a solution is a candidate relation to check against thm:main
attackers.certificate: an exact Groebner or linear-algebra certificate of (in)consistency
attackers.stop_rule: stop at the certificate; a solution is not a closure until the relation is checked on a member
attackers.result: never run

attackers.piece: what blowing up the variety does to the obstruction: the Hodge classes and the defect of Bl_Z X in every degree
attackers.method: construct/blowup.py: the blow-up formula H^k(Bl_Z X) = H^k(X) + sum_{i<c} H^{k-2i}(Z)(-i) (Voisin I, Thm 7.31) applied to Hodge numbers and to the defects; the defect of the blow-up is the defect of X plus those of the centre, so the wall relocates and never falls; a centre of dimension at most two, or an abelian threefold, adds nothing
attackers.certificate: the formula is a refereed theorem; the bookkeeping is exact integer arithmetic, tested on P^2, a point and a curve in a threefold
attackers.stop_rule: stop: this stage is a proved negative, it tells the other attackers not to blow up
attackers.result: blow-ups relocate the obstruction: def_k(Bl_Z X) = def_k(X) + sum_{i=1}^{c-1} def_{k-i}(Z); nothing is removed

attackers.piece: blowing up the certified set of discriminants: which Weil discriminants follow by products from the certified ones, and what one more certificate would buy
attackers.method: construct/blowup.py: a discriminant is a class in Q^*/N(K^*), K = Q(sqrt(-d)); by Hasse it is the vector of Hilbert symbols (delta, -d)_v at the places dividing 2 d delta and infinity; algebraicity is multiplicative under products (Schoen, H8 cor:prodalg), so the certified classes span an F_2-subspace, computed exactly
inputs: Serre, A Course in Arithmetic, III
attackers.certificate: the Hilbert-symbol computation checked by the product formula and by the norm lists of Q(i), Q(sqrt-3), Q(sqrt-7); the multiplicativity is Schoen's refereed proposition
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the span is written; it grows only when a construction certifies a new class
attackers.result: from the single certified class 1 (Markman) the span is {1} for every K: products buy nothing yet; one certified nontrivial class, say 3 for Q(i), would at once give 3, 6, 15 (its coset by the norms) and leave 7, 11, 21, each prime a new independent class, so (F2) needs infinitely many independent certificates per field unless a construction works uniformly in the discriminant

attackers.piece: a hyperkahler carrier of Weil classes at a discriminant other than one
attackers.method: blow up the setting: replace the K3^[n]-type carriers by moduli of sheaves on an abelian surface (generalised Kummer type) or by O'Grady's tenfolds, and test whether the Weil classes of a nontrivial-discriminant member occur in H^2 of a carrier
attackers.certificate: a carrier with an explicit class whose restriction is a Weil class of discriminant d != 1
attackers.stop_rule: stop when either every deformation type is excluded by the lattice of H^2 or one carrier is found
attackers.result: not attempted

attackers.piece: whether anything the engine already holds implies (F2) or (F3')
attackers.method: search controls/, tasks.json and the atlas for a certified statement that implies (F2) or (F3'); the only known implications are HC itself and the two together
attackers.certificate: an independently checked certificate of a statement that implies the target
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the search is exhausted; with the bundled data the answer is none
attackers.result: nothing in the engine implies (F2) or (F3'); controls/hodge.json says: Open, no candidate closure

strategy: Diagonalise: (F2) is the conjunction, over the Mumford-Tate types of Moonen-Zarhin, of the pieces 'the exceptional classes of this type are algebraic'; each piece has its own status, and the engine attacks the open pieces, not the conjunction.

Pincer every open piece: a construction agent builds the object the method needs, and a refuter agent tries to prove that no such object exists for that method; the piece ends either with a certified object or with a proved wall, never with 'tried and gave up'.

Change the carrier, not the class: when the semiregular object cannot exist (the refuter wins), move the Weil class to a variety where it is a degree-two class (a hyperkahler carrier) or a product (stabilisation), and attack there.
Work at the frontier instance only: Weil classes on abelian fourfolds of Weil type with nontrivial discriminant are the first open piece of (F2); every other attacker here feeds that piece or (F3').
For (F3'), push the class A outward along reductions that are proved (simplex type to Fermat, dominant rational maps, products), and name the first variety outside A rather than the whole complement.
Last step only: the bypass stage searches what the engine holds for an implication of the target; it closes only on a certificate and is never a substitute for one.

strings.statement: The Geometric Selection Conjecture: a heterotic vacuum meeting (C1)-(C9) exists on a Calabi-Yau threefold outside L^mu, on a component carrying no standard embedding (Theorem D of creelie/strings makes GSC equivalent to a viable vacuum fixed by mu wherever mu is defined, and construct/gsc_mirror_fixed.py proves that a mu-fixed vacuum has no families, so the clause is met exactly by the vacua outside L^mu).

gaps.papers_do: the paper states (C7)-(C9) (moduli stabilisation, Yukawa hierarchies, supersymmetry breaking) as physical requirements
gaps.missing: they are not inequalities: no scale, window or threshold is fixed, so no vacuum can be checked against them and no theorem can be stated

gaps.papers_do: the paper scans positive monads on the quintic and its quotients
gaps.missing: the scan is exhausted: the two three-family positive monads on quintic quotients are known (Braun; Anderson-Gray-He-Lukas) and both fail (C3); nothing off the quintic or non-positive was scanned

gaps.papers_do: the no-three-families wall is proved for the standard embedding and mu-fixed vacua
gaps.missing: the line-bundle standard models on CICYs with h11 >= 2 that pass (C1)-(C6) in the literature are never tested against the paper's conditions

gaps.papers_do: the paper proves mu-fixed vacua carry no families
gaps.missing: closed: construct/gsc_mirror_fixed.py proves that a mu-fixed vacuum of L^mu is self-mirror, so chi = 0, c_3(V) = 0 on its component and the index vanishes; GSC is reduced to vacua outside L^mu (note in creelie/geometric-selection-conjecture v1.0.0); the proof is checked by its own producer only

gaps.papers_do: numerical Ricci-flat metrics are used for Yukawa couplings
gaps.missing: no error bars, so (C8) cannot be certified even once (C8) is an inequality

attackers.piece: (C7)-(C9) as inequalities: moduli masses >= m_0, Yukawa eigenvalue ratios in stated windows at a stated scale, a gravitino mass window
attackers.method: construct/reformulate.py: state the strongest well-defined form, then weaken until a published model is not trivially excluded; the numbers are Deep's choice
attackers.certificate: a definition whose consequences are checkable on one explicit vacuum
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the three conditions are inequalities with named constants
attackers.result: not done; blocks every later stage

attackers.piece: non-positive monads and extension bundles on the Dwork quintic modulo Z5 x Z5 with three net families and a Standard-Model breaking
attackers.method: construct/monads.py extended to non-positive terms: c1, anomaly, index -75, Heisenberg multiplicities, then Wilson-line breaking of the GUT group
attackers.certificate: a bundle passing (C1)-(C3) exactly, with stability checked
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the finite scan is exhausted or one bundle passes (C3)
attackers.result: positive monads: exactly two three-family bundles on quintic quotients, the SU(5) one on the Dwork pencil proved at (C1)-(C2), both fail (C3)

attackers.piece: line-bundle standard models on CICYs with h11 >= 2 passing (C1)-(C6), tested against the repaired (C7)-(C9)
attackers.method: take the AGLP models (1106.4804, 1202.1757) and the SU(5) scan of Constantin et al., check (C1)-(C6) exactly, then the repaired conditions
attackers.certificate: one model passing all nine conditions as stated, each check exact or with certified error
attackers.stop_rule: stop at the first model passing, or when the published lists are exhausted
attackers.result: not started; needs s.definition-repair first

attackers.piece: whether a mu-fixed (2,2) vacuum has chi = 0
attackers.method: check the argument against the paper's mirror-pairs remark; if it holds, GSC reduces to vacua outside L^mu and the wall mu-fixed-has-no-families is a consequence
attackers.certificate: a written proof checked by someone other than its author
attackers.stop_rule: stop when the proof is checked or a counterexample vacuum is found
attackers.result: proved: a fixed point is isomorphic to its mirror, so h11 = h21 and chi = 0; its component carries a (2,2) point, so c_3(V) = chi = 0 and the index c_3/2 is zero on every free quotient; GSC is equivalent to a viable vacuum outside L^mu (construct/gsc_mirror_fixed.py, 511 checks; note creelie/geometric-selection-conjecture v1.0.0); not yet checked by anyone other than its author, so the stage stays short of its certificate

attackers.piece: physical Yukawa couplings with error bars on one candidate vacuum
attackers.method: cymetric-style numerical metric with a posteriori error estimates; report intervals
attackers.certificate: none: numerical only, never counted as proof
attackers.stop_rule: stop when intervals are reported; this stage can never close
attackers.result: not started

attackers.piece: accept a published three-family model as meeting (C7)-(C9) by the physics literature's own standard
attackers.method: last step: GSC follows by Theorem D, conditional on the unproved physical inputs
attackers.certificate: none: the result is conditional on physics inputs and is labelled so
attackers.stop_rule: stop immediately; this is a bypass, never a closure
attackers.result: not a closure

strategy: Repair the definitions before any scan: (C7)-(C9) as inequalities with named constants, so that a vacuum can fail them.
Scan what the literature already certifies at (C1)-(C6) before building new bundles.
Pincer: every candidate bundle meets construct/monads.refute before it is recorded.

gaps.missing: |2 Delta| over all 473.8M polytopes and chain_bound3 are uncomputed, and the endpoint restriction to r-minimal pairs is unused
